description: Burndown and flow metrics for the vault's tasks, computed from their recorded history. `scope` is a concept id (an iteration, milestone, feature, domain or any concept tasks are part_of / realize, including nested containers) or `tag:<tag>`; omit it for every task. Returns, for the window: open vs done over time with an ideal line when the scope has start/end dates, scope changes, velocity per iteration or week, a projected completion date with an optimistic/pessimistic range, lead and cycle time per agent label, and claims held longer than `staleAfterHours`. `metrics` limits the sections returned. Read-only.

bucket.description: Series granularity. Default: day for windows up to 120 days, else week.

from.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO). Default: the scope's startDate, else 8 weeks ago.

metrics.description: Sections to include: series, scopeChanges, velocity, projection, cycle, agents, stale (default all).

scope.description: A concept id (iteration, milestone, feature, domain, …) or `tag:<tag>`. Omit for every task in the vault.

staleAfterHours.description: A claim held longer than this is stale (default 24).

to.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO). Default: the later of the scope's endDate and now.

unit.description: Count tasks (default) or sum their `estimate` points.

name: burndown
title: Task burndown
